property_summary: For owner with balance 10, calling burn(10) succeeds and reduces totalSupply by 10 in the reference, but reverts in the buggy version because require(balanceOf[msg.sender] > _value) fails; the divergence is totalSupply after the call.
change_summary: Replace require(balanceOf[msg.sender] >= _value) with require(balanceOf[msg.sender] > _value) to allow burn only for amounts strictly less than balance.
